Appearance

Serene tiefling with violet skin and glowing golden eyes. Wears ethereal robes that shimmer like the night sky.

What We Know

Professor of Divination at the Highreach Wizard's Tower. Revered for uncanny insights and prophetic visions. Guides students to see beyond the present.

First Impressions

Calm and contemplative — her soft voice carries a faint echo, as if she's conversing with something unseen.
